# Charlotte Hornets 2026/27 Season: Ultimate Preview & Insider Secrets!

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-07-21, 40:08. https://youtu.be/EB1Z_6n56-o

## Summary

Josh Lloyd talks with Walker Mehl of Locked On Hornets to preview the Charlotte Hornets after a big offseason. Charlotte traded LaMelo Ball to Minnesota and Miles Bridges away. They brought in Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale, Grayson Allen and Dorian Finney-Smith, drafted Hunter Steinbach and Christian Anderson, and re-signed Coby White to start at point guard. The projected starters are Coby White, Kon Knueppel, Brandon Miller, Naz Reid and Moussa Diabaté. Steinbach is expected to be the next big man and Ryan Kalkbrenner the last. The team will lean further into shooting threes, steals and offensive rebounds, and playmaking will come from several players instead of one. Walker predicts 43 wins and names Coby White as the player who sets the team's ceiling. Josh adds that lottery reform should push up win totals at the bottom of the league.

## Rules and methods

- [20:22](https://youtu.be/EB1Z_6n56-o?t=1222) When a team is out of contention, games a player misses with injuries can look worse than they are. On a good team, the same player may play through those injuries.
  > "when this team is good he'll play through them and yeah, that's what happened"
- [36:43](https://youtu.be/EB1Z_6n56-o?t=2203) With lottery reform, fewer teams will finish with very low win totals. Wins shift away from the middle and top teams, so expect win projections to bunch closer together.
  > "with the lottery reform system, there's not going to be four teams that finish under 25"
- [36:51](https://youtu.be/EB1Z_6n56-o?t=2211) Bad teams that used to win about 17 games may now win about 24, because they will play their regular players late in the season.
  > "These bad 17 win teams might be 24 win teams."
- [6:47](https://youtu.be/EB1Z_6n56-o?t=407) When a player has an outlier shooting season on high volume, expect the volume to come back down toward his career norm.
  > "Grayson, the outlier shooting year for him, just happened this past season and the volume's going to come back down"
